title: Medical Sales Representative
description:
**Company Description** 
 Core Kind Wellness is dedicated to making everyday health feel simpler, kinder, and more understood. The company creates science\-led wellness solutions designed for real bodies, diverse needs, and every stage of life. Its approach emphasizes informed and intentional health choices that fit seamlessly into daily routines. Core Kind Wellness focuses on accessible, evidence\-based products that support sustainable, long\-term wellbeing for a broad range of individuals.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Medical Sales Representative role based in Kolkata. The Medical Sales Representative will build and maintain relationships with healthcare professionals, pharmacies, and wellness centers to promote Core Kind Wellness products. Daily responsibilities include conducting product presentations, explaining clinical and scientific benefits, managing sales inquiries, and providing follow\-up support to customers. The role involves regular field visits, gathering market feedback, tracking sales performance, and collaborating with internal teams to ensure accurate product information and effective promotional activities. The representative will also support customer education initiatives to ensure that product use aligns with Core Kind Wellness’s standards of care and wellness.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong medical sales skills, including territory management and relationship building.
* Candidates should possess excellent communication and customer service skills to interact effectively with healthcare professionals and clients.
* Candidates should possess foundational knowledge of medicine to clearly explain product benefits and indications.
* Candidates should possess familiarity with pharmacy operations, including product dispensing and inventory practices.
* Additional beneficial qualifications include prior experience in pharmaceutical or wellness product sales, the ability to work independently in the field, strong organizational and reporting skills, and proficiency with basic office and CRM software.
* A relevant diploma or degree in life sciences, pharmacy, or a related field is preferred; willingness to engage in ongoing product and industry training is expected.

title: Amazon Account Manager
description:
**Summary**
 :
 


* We are looking for an experienced Amazon Account Manager who can manage client accounts end to end and confidently handle day\-to\-day client communication.
* You will work directly with US\-based clients, understand their business, products, Amazon account setup, priorities, and ongoing requirements, and coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth execution across listings, catalog, inventory, operations, account health, reporting, and other marketplace activities.
* This is a client\-facing role, so strong communication skills and prior experience working with international clients are essential. We are looking for someone who can take ownership, identify issues, advise clients, follow up internally, and make sure things get resolved properly.



  





**Key Responsibilities**



* Manage a portfolio of Amazon client accounts on a day\-to\-day basis.
* Act as the main point of contact for assigned US\-based clients.
* Onboard new clients and understand their products, business goals, Amazon setup, and priorities.
* Handle regular client calls, emails, meetings, updates, and follow\-ups.
* Support clients in growing their Amazon business by advising on sales strategy, marketing opportunities, promotions, product positioning, and ways to improve account performance.
* Maintain a clear understanding of ongoing activities across each client account.
* Coordinate with internal teams handling catalog, listings, inventory, operations, analytics, finance, and support.
* Monitor product listings, inventory, orders, fulfillment, returns, account health, and seller performance.
* Identify account\-related or operational issues and coordinate with the relevant teams for resolution.
* Track pending tasks and ensure client requests and internal commitments are completed on time.
* Keep clients updated on progress, issues, performance, and next steps.
* Understand Amazon policies, listing requirements, seller performance metrics, and marketplace processes.
* Identify opportunities to improve sales, account performance, and overall operations.
* Take complete ownership of assigned accounts rather than simply passing queries between teams.



  





**Requirements**



* 3\-5 years of experience in Amazon account management, e\-commerce operations, marketplace management, or a similar role.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Amazon Seller Central and/or Vendor Central.
* Prior experience working directly with international clients is a must.
* Experience handling US\-based clients will be strongly preferred.
* Strong written and spoken English with the confidence to communicate professionally over calls, emails, and meetings.
* Good understanding of:


1. Product listings and catalog management
2. Inventory management
3. Orders and fulfillment
4. Returns
5. Account health
6. Seller performance
7. Amazon policies and compliance


* Experience managing Amazon accounts for brands or sellers.
* Ability to understand client requirements, identify problems, recommend solutions, and take ownership until resolution.
* Strong coordination and follow\-up skills.
* Comfortable working with multiple internal teams at the same time.
* Good working knowledge of Excel and Google Sheets.
* Organised, proactive, dependable, and comfortable working in a fast\-moving environment.



  





**What We’re Looking For**



* We are looking for someone who understands Amazon beyond just one area of operations and is equally comfortable managing the client relationship and managing the account.
* You should be able to confidently discuss listings, catalog issues, inventory, account health, seller performance, sales, marketing opportunities, and account growth with clients while ensuring the required work gets executed properly internally.
* The ideal candidate will be comfortable working with international clients, communicating professionally, and taking complete ownership of their assigned accounts.

title: Manager - Thermal Sales (Alu & Dri)
description:
**Job Summary**
 The Manager – Thermal Sales (ALU \& DRI) is responsible for driving sales growth and business development for thermal products in the Aluminium (ALU) and Direct Reduced Iron (DRI) segments across specified territory across Eastern and Central India. The role focuses on achieving sales targets, managing key customer relationships, identifying new business opportunities, providing technical and commercial support, negotiating contracts, and ensuring customer satisfaction. The incumbent collaborates closely with cross\-functional teams, monitors market trends and competitor activities, develops strategic sales plans, and contributes to business profitability while ensuring compliance with company policies and safety standards.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve revenue, volume, and profitability targets for the assigned territory.
* Manage key customer accounts in the Aluminium (ALU) and DRI segments while strengthening long\-term business relationships.
* Identify and develop new business opportunities to expand the customer base and market share.
* Conduct regular customer visits to understand technical requirements, resolve issues, and provide value\-added solutions.
* Prepare techno\-commercial proposals, quotations, and negotiate pricing and commercial terms.
* Coordinate with Production, Technical Services, Supply Chain, Finance, and Customer Service teams to ensure timely order execution and customer satisfaction.
* Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and customer requirements to identify growth opportunities.
* Prepare sales forecasts, demand plans, and periodic MIS reports for management review.
* Ensure timely collection of receivables and maintain healthy customer credit management.
* Participate in technical discussions, product trials, and application development at customer sites.
* Represent the organization during customer meetings, industry events, exhibitions, and technical seminars.
* Maintain accurate records in CRM/ERP systems and ensure compliance with company policies and procedures.
* Support product launches, business expansion initiatives, and strategic projects as assigned.
* Ensure adherence to all safety, quality, ethical, and statutory requirements while conducting business activities.


**Profile/Competencies**
 Education
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Metallurgical, Ceramic, Chemical, or related discipline).
* MBA/PGDM in Marketing or Sales Management will be an added advantage.


**Experience**
* 8–12 years of experience in B2B industrial sales, preferably in refractories, thermal products, steel, aluminium, or allied process industries.
* Experience in handling customers within the Aluminium, Non\-ferrous and DRI segments is preferred.


**Technical Competencies**
* Strong understanding of thermal/refractory products and their industrial applications.
* Knowledge of Aluminium, Non\-ferrous and DRI manufacturing processes.
* Techno\-commercial negotiation and contract management.
* Sales forecasting, budgeting, and territory management.
* CRM and ERP systems (preferably Oracle/SAP) and MS Office proficiency.


**Behavioral Competencies**
* Strong customer relationship management skills.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation abilities.
* Commercial acumen and business development mindset.
* Analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Results\-oriented with strong execution capability.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across cross\-functional teams.
* High level of ownership, integrity, and accountability.
* Willingness to travel extensively across the assigned region.


**Calderys Group**
 Calderys is a leading global solution provider for industries operating in high temperature conditions . The Group specializes in thermal protection for industrial equipment with a wide range of refractory products, and advanced solutions to enhance steel casting, metallurgical fluxes and molding processes.
   

  

 As an international business with a presence in more than 30 countries and a strong footprint in the Americas through the brand HWI, a member of Calderys, we offer our employees a world of opportunity.
   

  

 With a legacy of over 150 years, and an unwavering commitment to excellence, we continue to shape our future through teamwork, customer\-centricity and a proactive mindset. We are the vital partner of all high temperature industries and our purpose places sustainability and innovation at the heart of our business. It reflects our reason for existing: to support our customers building a better world through sustainable solutions.
   

  

 Our values are a driving force in this purpose: We are tenacious, accountable, multicultural and authentic..
   

  

 In our company, performance is recognized and learning is promoted. Our services and solutions depend upon the expertise and commitment of our employees. So we ensure that they have the scope and opportunities to develop their potential within a diverse, inclusive and collaborative setting. It is an environment for people to grow, where every day is a new day and more exciting than the last.
   

  

 Calderys \- Forged in legacy. Fueled by excellence.
